extensionDescription.message: A browser extension toolbox for YouTube (www.youtube.com).

popupSubtitle.message: A browser extension toolbox for YouTube (www.youtube.com).

authorDescription.message: Group by each channel’s first appearance, then order each group by upload date, oldest first. Later duplicate videos are removed.

dateDescription.message: Order all videos by upload date, oldest first. Videos with the same date retain their relative order. Later duplicate videos are removed.

copyDescription.message: Create a private copy of the current playlist.

cacheDescription.message: Progress appears on the page. Each playlist has its own cache; incremental scans retrieve new videos.

panelOpened.message: The action panel is open. Progress appears on the page.

exportOpened.message: The Save As dialog is open.

closingPanel.message: Stopping. The panel will close after the current request.

panelFinished.message: You can close this panel. Open it from the toolbox for another action.

platformSupport.message: Supports playlist copying, sorting by creator or upload date, and importing a channel’s videos. Editable playlists only.

importChannelDescription.message: Read videos from the current channel and add them to your playlist oldest-first. Videos already in the playlist are skipped.

openChannelPrompt.message: Open a YouTube channel, channel videos tab, or watch page.

destPlaylistPlaceholder.message: Paste a PL… ID or playlist URL
